en: A color-illustrated street scene in a European city, showing a broad avenue or square lined with multi‑story historic buildings and trees. At the center background stands a tall Baroque-style church tower with an ornate spire. People walk and gather along the street, and storefronts with awnings line the ground floors. The image is framed by a white border, typical of printed postcards. A small, painterly signature appears in the lower right corner.
